category2_entry.text: Compounded drugs containing Kisspeptin-10 may pose risk for immunogenicity for certain routes of administration and may have complexities with regard to peptide-related impurities and API characterization. FDA has no, or only limited, safety-related information for the proposed routes of administration. Therefore, the agency lacks sufficient information to know whether the drug would cause harm when administered to humans.

analysis.note: Jabbit analysis. Short exposure to kisspeptin raises LH and testosterone; sustained or frequent exposure blunts the response, and continuous exposure to a potent analog drove testosterone into the castration range. Takeda's two phase 2a trials using an analog to raise testosterone were terminated for missing their primary endpoints. Human studies are small, short and mostly IV or single injections under supervision.
